title: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 375, Section 3 of the Acts of 1981 (Section 12M of Chapter 25, G.L. ) as amended by Chapter 233 of the Acts of 1983 (Section 17A of Chapter 25, G.L.) and as further amended by Chapter 516 of the Acts of 1987, the Commission of the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment on the intra-state revenue of electric companies for the purpose of providing funds for the administration and operation of the Fuel Charge Monitoring Bureau.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners participating: McIntyre, Chariman; Tierney and Werlin.

In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 375, Section 3, of the Acts of 1981. ( Section 12M Chapter 25, G.L.) as amended by chapter 233 pf the acts of 1983 (Section 17 A of chapter 25, G.L.). Further amended by chapter 516 of the acts of 1987. The Commission of the Department of Public Utilities, hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-State Revenue of Electric Companies, for the purpose of providing funds for the administration and operation of the Fuel Charge Monitoring Bureau.
